correctness.rationale: The exact 2008 prime-power period theorem yields unique n=mp with 2<=m<=p in the e=1 layer. Higher prime-power exceptions contribute O(X^(2/3)log X); finite q-divisor primes are negligible. Centering yields a periodic zero-mean weight, permitting Abel summation. Effective PNT and li(t)-t/log(t) decomposition isolate a conditionally convergent harmonic coefficient with O_q(X/log^2X) remainder. Mobius inclusion-exclusion evaluates that coefficient. Brute periods through k=8 and 12000-parameter arithmetic diagnostics passed, but are not substitutes for the infinite proof.
